original_card.question: What explicit uniform stock envelope does the actual selected stopped producer supply at one bootstrap stage?
methods: Derive a source-bound reserve recurrence at the actual selected atom widths, separating parent stock from completed inner borrowing.
Find an exact missing implication or counterexample to a proposed selected-stage stock envelope.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Bind every coefficient and depth factor to the selected producer and state the width domain. Compare a proved envelope with the sufficient cutoff guard; a large numerical headroom or a historical m=120 coefficient is not a selected m=73 proof.

first_step.inspect: Read #2972 stock-margin chain and the selected stock audit. The new source archive reports the remaining cutoff comparisons, but leaves every actual stock coefficient unresolved; it is not an independently validated reserve envelope.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only. Read the named package and review before relying on its local evidence; this command is not its replay or supplier admission.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one actual selected producer/stage and derive its parent reserve and depth coefficient from source. Check whether newer handoffs already cover that exact obligation. Stop with the missing implementation lemma if it cannot be bounded; do not rerun #2972 cutoff/headroom arithmetic as a new contribution.
original_card.bottleneck_link: This reduces a concrete inherited implementation obligation without confusing unchanged kappa arithmetic with a completed theorem.
allowed_variations: One stage or one explicit reserve/depth implication.
An independently checked same-domain proof repair, retaining all remaining assumptions.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the historical 57604 or 252 allowance without a selected-producer binding.
Calling a conditional fit lemma a full outer-proof adoption.
Replacing an actual selected stock coefficient with cutoff comparisons or a conditional fit inequality.

existing_checks.scope: Retained stock audit identifies missing actual selected-stage coefficients; later cutoff-chain arithmetic does not supply them.
existing_checks.remaining: Derive one actual reserve/depth coefficient from the selected producer.

actual_scope: For the selected m=73 complex stopped producer, realize the completed ordinary-leaf interface on one complex residual class: the peeled-atom remainder of every coarse node (n = 73f + delta) and the bounded stopped leaf (n < 73). Bind the residual's call plan to source for every n, execute its ordinary calls through the published completed ordinary engine with the parent leaf reserve as a preceding spectator, and show that the residual needs no external leaf reserve (S_leaf = 1 on this class). Leave routing, high-part exchange, adapters, global rho, A, B and the finite-stock-as-C admission to others.
scope_change_reason: #3113 left rho unbound and #3421 left it open after A=0. A citation-only rho=0 via the #2105 S_leaf=1 permission was deferred because that permission is conditional on the completed ordinary-leaf contract being available on the complex side. This package answers the realization step that the deferral named: one complex residual whose ordinary calls are exhibited, executed and checked under the completed interface, with the reserve-independence observed rather than assumed.
bottleneck_link: The selected kappa binds through the m=73 complex producer. sigma <= (43/26)*(1-s)*(A+B) + rho needs an actual leaf-reserve binding; realizing the peeled/stopped-leaf calls removes one of the four leaf-call classes named by PR185 from the unrealized set without changing kappa arithmetic.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact all-n plan, physical execution of the peeled residual and n<73 leaf through the published completed ordinary engine (elementary and fitted branches) with parent reserve extents 1 and >1, four mutation controls and an independent replay. Do not claim global rho=0, do not realize routing/high-part/adapter calls, do not recompute A=0 or B_bits=2642, do not substitute 252 or 57604, and do not claim a new kappa.
evidence: verify.py (PASS_SELECTED_COMPLEX_PEELED_LEAF) re-hashes 25 pinned inputs including every importable file of research/physical-ordinary-interchange before importing it, checks 16 source citations, replays the exact m=73 peel plan for every n < 1533 (all 73 residues delta, at most 72 calls, peeled pairs plus coarse middle equal F_n, parent reserve never active), executes 12 physical residual cases (q=2,3,5; delta 1-3; n<73 leaves; reserve extents 1 and 3) through the unchanged completed binary interface with per-column provenance, and rejects four controls. verify.py --suite fitted runs one peeled pair through the fitted internally-borrowing branch: C0 returns every column with its parent-reserve coordinate, and the fresh-row padding ratio 3/2 (own rows 8 -> 12) is independent of reserve extent. independent.py recomputes the plan and all engine payload hashes without importing the engine. No new kappa (0.001672660197076918).
author: Wentao Li
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for source reading, plan derivation, engine harness and verifier construction, controls, and writeup (no product or model names).

open_questions.question: Can the remaining PR185 leaf-call classes of the complex producer (fixed cover routing and high-part exchange / residual digits) be realized the same way, so that S_leaf = 1 holds for every leaf call and rho = 0 is bound rather than cited?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This package realizes S_leaf = 1 only on the peeled-atom residual and n<73 stopped leaves. Global rho needs every leaf-call class of the m=73 producer.
open_questions.first_step: Write the high-part exchange of notes/three-stage-cover-rows.tex (width k = ceil(log_q S) ordinary interchange of H_hi and D_hi with bodies and Z as spectators) as one call signature (k; P, G, S) of the same engine and check that the parent reserve lies in P.
open_questions.blocked_by: The routing calls of the complex cover are not written as ordinary interchanges in the pinned complex note; the high-part exchange width depends on the unadmitted uniform C(w).
